theme: A clear day in St. Pete — the day to clear the holiday-travel backlog, with Toronto a week out.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar is nearly empty — one NACD session at 1 — so the real opening today is for the holiday bookings that have been waiting since September. ICGN Toronto is a week away.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Maine Christmas SUV before it sells out
needsAttention.detail: Your p1 Todoist task to book a refundable full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week has been open since mid-September. It's the hardest rental in that market over the holidays, inventory sells out, and a refundable hold costs nothing now.

needsAttention.title: Shortlist the December-break destinations
needsAttention.detail: The p2 task to pick three options for the Dec 13–Jan 2 stretch with all four girls had a book-by-Oct-15 target that has now passed. Holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so every day of delay narrows the field.

schedule.title: NACD program
schedule.detail: An hour on board oversight — useful ground for the seats you're pursuing.

flagged.title: Valoris sent the boards brochure
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano shared the Valoris Boards brochure as you weigh joining the partnership — worth a read before the Nov 5 Valoris/FinCity call.

flagged.title: Elder-care conditions escalated at Tampa Gardens
flagged.detail: Shari Zwirn flagged the broken A/C and room cleanliness in Sandra's unit to the facility director and asked family to call; you're cc'd, so expect a possible follow-up.

inbox.noise: A LinkedIn invite, a BBYO reunion update, a mail-delay notice, and a cold board-search pitch asking you to reply "Send brief."

acts.line: A clear morning in St. Pete, the kind of open stretch the overdue holiday-rental bookings have been waiting for.
A single board session anchors the early afternoon, and everything around it is yours to direct.
The girls are with you and Mike this week, a settled evening before the rhythm shifts toward Sunday's handoff.
